reason: The hypothesis directly restates the core mechanistic insight from P8/P9/P16/P26/P35—that controlling reduction kinetics to achieve simultaneous reduction prevents phase separation—and applies it to the same noble metal system (Pt, Ir, Rh, Os, Ru) studied in P1, merely proposing a different method (ligand modification) to achieve that synchronization. This is a minor variation on a well-established idea from the cited literature, not a new synthesis or transfer.
